# Security policy

Please do not post credentials, access tokens, private webhook payloads, or real customer data in a public issue.

This repository contains only example configuration and deterministic fixtures. If you find a security issue in the code, open a minimal report that contains no deployable secret. Rotate any credential accidentally shared before reporting it.

The public project is a portfolio reference implementation, not a hosted multi-tenant service. Operators are responsible for current n8n/PostgreSQL security updates, TLS, provider permissions, and environment-specific secret management.
